classification.difficultyReason: The hypotenuse is unknown, so the equation has x in the denominator. It is solved twice, once with the marked angle and once after finding the unmarked 55°.

content.prompt: Find the length of the side labelled $x$. Round your answers to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked:
$9$ is adjacent to $35^\circ$; $x$ is the hypotenuse.
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{A}{H}\\\cos35^\circ&=\frac{9}{x}\\x\cos35^\circ&=9\\x&=\frac{9}{\cos35^\circ}\\x&\approx10.99\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: By using the unmarked angle in the triangle.

answer.worked:
The unmarked angle is $180^\circ-90^\circ-35^\circ=55^\circ$. $9$ is opposite $55^\circ$; $x$ is the hypotenuse.
$$\begin{align*}\sin\theta&=\frac{O}{H}\\\sin55^\circ&=\frac{9}{x}\\x\sin55^\circ&=9\\x&=\frac{9}{\sin55^\circ}\\x&\approx10.99\end{align*}$$
